summary: A CCC-built 1934 lookout in Lassen National Forest; a closure reported in January 2026 was reversed in February, and the 2026 season status is unconfirmed.

facts.design: 14x14 ft L-4 cab with catwalk on a 30-ft steel tower

access.note: Active lookout. The register says it is open from June until late October. Its closure was reversed in February 2026; I found no later report.

events.note: Civilian Conservation Corps replaced the 1912 lookout with the present L-4 cab on a 30-ft steel tower
Registered October 6, 2001; nominated by Ken Jordan, primary lookout
Jordan was told he would not return the next year; KRCR reported the tower was slated for demolition

Per the Los Angeles Times (January 2026), the Forest Service had shut the lookout; a spokesperson wrote that it was closed for the winter, as each year, and that no decision had been made about its future
Chico Enterprise-Record reported that the Forest Service reversed the closure and the lookout would remain staffed for fire season

notes_for_editor: Most recent report found is the Chico Enterprise-Record of February 6, 2026; only its lede was readable (subscriber article). Status for the 2026 season and beyond is unconfirmed; check before publishing any access claim. Ken Jordan's tenure is given three ways: 35th year in 2019 (register), 41 years (KRCR, October 2025), 40 years (Chico Enterprise-Record caption). Story gives all three. A Facebook result in search claims the tower was added to the National Register on May 23, 1986; I did not read it and did not use it. ActionNewsNow returned 429 and was not read. Access level restricted is my judgment from the register's seasonal open period and the active-lookout status. Staffing is set to unknown: the February 2026 Chico report says the lookout will remain staffed for fire season, but no later report confirms the 2026 season.
